title: Sonar Sweep
description: Count depth measurement increases using sliding windows of size 1 and 3.
writeup:
## Approach

A sliding window comparison problem. The key insight for part 2 is that comparing two overlapping windows of size 3 reduces to comparing just the element entering vs the element leaving.

## Part 1

Count how many times a depth measurement is greater than the previous one. A simple pairwise comparison.

## Part 2

Count how many times a sliding window sum of 3 increases. Since consecutive windows share 2 elements, the sum increases exactly when `depths[i] > depths[i-3]` — the new element exceeds the dropped one. No need to actually compute window sums.
